title: rename_resource
description: Renames an infrastructure or application resource (e.g. a Kubernetes object, Terraform resource, or Helm release) from an old name to a new name.

resource_type.description: The type of resource to rename (e.g. 'Deployment', 'Service', 'aws_s3_bucket', 'helm_release').

old_name.description: The current name of the resource before the rename operation.

new_name.description: The desired new name for the resource after the rename operation.
